description: Dependency-manifest hygiene check. POST package manifests (package.json, requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, go.mod, Gemfile, composer.json, pubspec.yaml, lockfiles) or an upload_id and get findings with severity + concrete fixes: wildcard/unbounded versions, missing lockfiles, unpinned installs, non-https indexes, install-script risks, dependency-confusion signals, and matches against a static snapshot of famously compromised packages. NOT a live CVE feed - pair with npm audit / pip-audit / osv-scanner for that. Deterministic, no network, no LLM.

filename.description: Required with upload_id so the manifest type can be detected.

upload_id.description: Alternative: a single manifest uploaded via the uploads tool.

name: dependency_check
